label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: Whatever is being moved in a respect is moved by…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., prima via: Movere enim nihil aliud est quam educere ... nisi per aliquod ens in actu
interpretation: Moving is identified with educing from potency to act, and such reduction requires an agent. Only the existence of a mover in the same respect is formalized here; that the mover is in act is carried by the separate in-act statement rather than repeated.
